what: The M3 notes explain scan types, port states and what Nmap output means, but the app has no command cheat sheet. Practise Nmap hands-on in a lab: its main options, timing templates, output formats and NSE scripts.
Not in the app. For NetBIOS, SNMP, LDAP, NTP, NFS, SMTP and DNS, know the port, what the service reveals when enumerated, and the countermeasure.

Not in the app. Learn the four phases (gaining access, escalating privileges, maintaining access, clearing logs): password attack types, privilege escalation, rootkits and backdoors, covering tracks, and the defence for each.
Not in the app. Learn the evasion technique families (fragmentation, insertion and evasion, obfuscation, tunnelling, spoofing, decoys) and how defenders detect each one.
Not in the app. At concept level, learn how network access control and endpoint protection (antivirus, EDR) get bypassed, and the countermeasures.

Not in the app. Learn the SQLi types (in-band, blind, out-of-band), the methodology, the tools the exam names (such as sqlmap), filter-evasion ideas, and the countermeasures (parameterized queries, input validation, WAF).

Not in the app. Learn the 802.11 standards, WEP, WPA, WPA2 and WPA3 and their weaknesses, wireless threats (rogue AP, evil twin), the wireless hacking methodology, the aircrack-ng suite, and the countermeasures.
